standards.title: Ontology authority and deterministic projection
standards.law: The admitted ontology, policy, and graph are authority; generated artifacts are projections.
obligations: Name authority, generator coordinate, generated paths, and replay command.
Refuse hand-authored mutation of generated surfaces.
Require second-sync byte identity.
exclusions: Does not require every repository to commit generated outputs.
Does not make metadata evidence of execution.
standards.falsifier: Mutate a generated output without changing its authority inputs; drift must be refused.

standards.title: Law-state manufacturing calculus
standards.law: Manufacturing follows parse, route, admit/refuse, diagnose/repair, construct, actuate, receipt, replay/hook.
obligations: Declare the stage changed by each work item.
Keep construction, actuation, verification, and standing distinct.
exclusions: Diagnosis has no inherited actuation authority.
standards.falsifier: Attempt actuation from diagnosis; the broker must refuse it.

standards.title: Maximal frontmatter
standards.law: Frontmatter is a complete admission carrier with identity, authority, constraints, evidence, replay, and nonclaims.
obligations: Preserve meaningful fields across projections.
Separate lifecycle from standing.
Include MUST/MUST NOT and allowed/forbidden paths.
exclusions: Serialization syntax is not fixed to one format.
standards.falsifier: Round-trip a record while deleting a MUST NOT boundary; the projection must refuse loss.

standards.title: Typed refusal and deterministic precedence
standards.law: Refusals are typed, state-preserving, externally visible, and precedence-tested.
obligations: Dry-run performs no mutation.
DuplicateReplay identity is checked before chain position.
Refused replay preserves verifier state.
exclusions: UNSUPPORTED is not coerced into policy denial.
standards.falsifier: Replay a duplicate out of order; expect DuplicateReplay and identical pre/post state.

standards.title: Zero direct actuation
standards.law: Architecture autonomics manufacture intents; BRCE owns the exclusive actuation path.
obligations: Set direct_actuation_allowed to false.
Name broker capability for every mutation.
Receipt every external consequence.
exclusions: No production actuation authority is granted by this profile.
standards.falsifier: Set direct_actuation_allowed true; doctor and controller must refuse.

standards.title: Canonical Building Block kernel
standards.law: One architecture kernel composes deterministic profiles with lifecycle and standing kept separate.
obligations: Expose one canonical kernel and CLI facade.
Refuse profile conflicts.
BLAKE3-receipt ordered composition inputs.
exclusions: Domain profiles do not become second kernels.
standards.falsifier: Create two conflicting profile claims; composition must return a typed conflict independent of input order.

standards.title: Combinatorial maximalism
standards.law: Maximize reversible graph construction under fail-closed gates before bounded atomic actuation.
obligations: Report explored, admitted, and refused combinations.
Use fail-closed semantic gates.
Use sabotage fixtures and exact-output replay.
exclusions: Large output volume alone is not conformance.
standards.falsifier: Disable one authority-bypass gate; a sabotage fixture must survive and fail the verifier.

standards.title: Deterministic non-LLM self-play
standards.law: Self-play uses ontology-authored scenarios, explicit actor state machines, real boundaries, receipts, and replay.
obligations: No LLM calls in deterministic crown.
Publish transition tables and boundary evidence.
Preserve deterministic ordering.
exclusions: A transcript without executed boundaries is not evidence.
standards.falsifier: Replace a real filesystem transition with a stub; multi-surface verification must fail.

standards.title: Multi-surface capability standing
standards.law: ALIVE requires same-object execution evidence corroborated across multiple proof surfaces.
obligations: Name capability count and proof-surface count.
Bind command, revision, inputs, outputs, failures, and nonclaims.
Use at least three relevant surfaces for crown claims.
exclusions: Multiple adjacent demonstrations do not corroborate a missing consequence.
standards.falsifier: Remove the causality surface while preserving logs; the crown must downgrade.

standards.title: Gall-grade deterministic work orders
standards.law: Checkpoint graphs project to dependency-closed tickets with complete contracts and executable acceptance.
obligations: Require MUST/MUST_NOT clauses.
Require allowed/forbidden paths and out-of-scope.
Require DAG dependencies, evidence, roles, and falsifier.
exclusions: An empty dependency set is valid and must not be replaced with invented edges.
standards.falsifier: Introduce a dependency cycle or orphan ticket; projection must refuse.

standards.title: Logical-time OCEL evidence
standards.law: Causal order uses admitted logical time and stable identities rather than wall-clock time alone.
obligations: Link events to work order, actor, artifact, capability, and receipt.
Preserve event identity and order across replay.
exclusions: Wall-clock time may remain an observation.
standards.falsifier: Replay with different wall-clock timing; causal event order must match.

standards.title: ggen-first Lean 4 to Rust admission
standards.law: Rendering, theorem admission, projection compilation, runtime execution, and certification retain separate standing.
obligations: Bind theorem and Lean kernel result.
Bind generated projection digest and compiler coordinate.
Correlate runtime verifier and receipt.
exclusions: Generated Rust is not itself a Lean proof.
standards.falsifier: Change the Rust projection while retaining theorem identity; correspondence verification must fail.

standards.title: Exact-head release law
standards.law: Promotion evidence binds to the exact candidate commit and exact required checks.
obligations: Checkout exact PR head or current commit.
Pin immutable action revisions.
Avoid hidden merge-queue coupling and make finalizers replay-safe.
exclusions: A finalizer name does not imply crown completeness.
standards.falsifier: Move the candidate head after verification; promotion must refuse stale evidence.

standards.title: Public namespace and identity
standards.law: Public object identity is distinct from repository location; metadata never implies standing.
obligations: Use https://chatmangpt.com namespace origin.
Keep repository identity and public object identity separate.
Keep standing UNKNOWN until evidence exists.
exclusions: Dereferenceability is desired where practical, not proof of execution.
standards.falsifier: Rename a repository; public object identity must remain stable.

standards.title: Dry-run refusal ordering
standards.law: Dry-run evaluates the same admission and refusal ordering while performing zero mutation.
obligations: Record state_before and state_after.
Assert equality when actuation is refused or dry-run is active.
exclusions: Dry-run success is not evidence that real actuation succeeded.
standards.falsifier: Run dry-run against a forbidden operation; expect the same typed refusal and no state delta.

standards.title: Independent BLAKE3 receipt replay
standards.law: Receipts bind current authority, ordered inputs, exact outputs, consequence identity, lineage, and replay.
obligations: Use BLAKE3 for ggen execution and composition identities.
Verify receipt independently of producer success claims.
Treat stale receipts as BUILD_BROKEN until regenerated.
exclusions: APS book receipts may retain their declared SHA-256 schema; this does not weaken ggen execution receipt law.
standards.falsifier: Modify one output byte and replay; exact-output verification must diverge.

nonclaims: APS did not execute the ggen implementation while admitting this profile.
This profile does not grant production actuation authority.
The source coordinate bounds admitted standards; it does not claim every ggen capability is complete.
ALIVE remains reserved for observed execution at the declared coordinate.
